title: Mist in the hollows, smoke that drifts, light under the water
summary: Layered mist and haze, smoke plumes that drift downwind, weather that varies across the map, and caustics in the shallows and on hulls and piers.
stage: game scenarios (--aivai, --scenario=support, --scenario=naval) off-screen at 1600x900, frozen and flipped with FL_DEBUG_AIR_FLIP
rationale: Atmosphere and caustics are a few percent of a wide frame, so each effect gets a tight crop of one frozen moment with OFF stacked over ON, an arrow and a caption, plus a flicker clip of the same frame toggling every second; two motion clips show the caustics running and a plume drifting.
source_ref: 78ff2411 plus the presentation commit on dines/volumetrics-weather-738062 (High preset unless noted, Godot 4.7.2 Forward+, Windows). Crops and labels: PIL; WebM: VP9 via Playwright ffmpeg.
